title: glechoma ballotifolia
intro: Glechoma ballotifolia, commonly known as Russian melissa or creeping lemon balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma ballotifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which help to calm the nervous system and relieve digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine.
